svg.title: The Cuban Missile Crisis: Missile Strike Ranges and US Naval Quarantine (October 1962)
svg.desc: Conic conformal GIS historical atlas map of North America and the Caribbean in October 1962 showing Soviet SS-4 MRBM (~1,100 NM) and SS-5 IRBM (~2,200 NM) geodesic nuclear strike ranges from San Cristóbal, Cuba, President Kennedy's 500-nautical-mile US Naval Quarantine arc, and Soviet ships turning back on 24 October 1962.

text.tspan: Sweeps New York, Chicago, Omaha SAC & Canada
